description: This file contains test cases for a proxy fallback system in a machine learning model API, utilizing pytest and asyncio to simulate various scenarios such as fallback behavior, retries, timeouts, and integration with external services like OpenAI's API.

methods.name: generate_key( session, i, models: list, calling_key="sk-1234", )
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a key for specified models via an HTTP POST request to a local server endpoint.

methods.name: chat_completion( session, key: str, model: str, messages: list, return_headers: bool = False, extra_headers: Optional[dict] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous POST request to simulate or test chat completion API behavior with optional fallback and header handling.

methods.name: test_chat_completion()
methods.description: Asynchronous test case for basic chat completion functionality.

methods.name: test_chat_completion_client_fallbacks(has_access)
methods.description: Test case for verifying fallback behavior when requesting chat completions with different models.

methods.name: test_chat_completion_with_retries()
methods.description: Test case ensuring retries and headers for rate limiting or timeouts are correctly handled.

methods.name: test_chat_completion_with_fallbacks()
methods.description: Test case for fallback mechanism when a model API is badly configured or unavailable.

methods.name: test_chat_completion_with_timeout()
methods.description: Test case for verifying timeout headers and failure when mock_timeout is enabled.

methods.name: test_chat_completion_with_timeout_from_request()
methods.description: Test with custom timeout headers to verify timeout handling.

methods.name: test_chat_completion_client_fallbacks_with_custom_message(has_access)
methods.description: Test fallback with custom fallback message content.

methods.name: bool make_request(client: AsyncOpenAI, model: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a chat completion request using OpenAI API and reports success or failure.

methods.name: bool run_good_model_test(client: AsyncOpenAI, num_requests: int)
methods.description: Runs multiple concurrent requests to a 'good' model to verify system stability.
